/* LoginMapper.Login */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.USER_ID AS userId , A.USER_NM AS userNm , A.USER_PW AS userPw , A.AUTH_CD AS authCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , "AUTH_LEVEL" , A.AUTH_CD , NULL ) AS authLevel , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , B.SITE_NO AS siteNo , B.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , C.NODE_NM AS nodeNm , A.MBL_NO_ENC AS mblNoEnc , A.EMAIL_ENC AS emailEnc
, A.PWD_LOCK_YN AS pwdLockYn , A.PWD_FAIL_CNT AS pwdFailCnt , A.PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME AS pwdLockExpireDtime , A.PWD_CHG_DTIME AS pwdChgDtime , A.WITHDRAWAL_DATE AS withdrawalDate
, A.LAST_LOGIN_DTIME AS lastLoginDtime , A.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus , A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE AS employmentType , A.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , A.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , A.UPDATE_NO AS updateNo , A.UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate FROM TB_USER A
LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE_NODE C ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = C.SITE_CD AND A.NODE_CD = C.NODE_CD ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (A.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE IS NULL OR A.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE <> 'DAILY') AND (B.USE_YN = 'Y' OR A.AUTH_CD = 'master')

/* LoginMapper.selectUserByUserCd */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.USER_ID AS userId , A.USER_NM AS userNm , A.USER_PW AS userPw , A.AUTH_CD AS authCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, "AUTH_LEVEL", A.AUTH_CD, NULL) AS authLevel , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , B.SITE_NO AS siteNo , B.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , C.NODE_NM AS nodeNm , A.MBL_NO_ENC AS mblNoEnc , A.EMAIL_ENC AS emailEnc , A.PWD_LOCK_YN AS pwdLockYn , A.PWD_FAIL_CNT AS pwdFailCnt , A.PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME AS pwdLockExpireDtime , A.PWD_CHG_DTIME AS pwdChgDtime , A.WITHDRAWAL_DATE AS withdrawalDate , A.LAST_LOGIN_DTIME AS lastLoginDtime , A.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus , A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE AS employmentType , A.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , A.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , A.UPDATE_NO AS updateNo , A.UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate FROM TB_USER A INNER JOIN TB_SITE B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE_NODE C ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = C.SITE_CD AND A.NODE_CD = C.NODE_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd}
mapper.update: /* LoginMapper.userPwdUnLock */ UPDATE TB_USER SET PWD_LOCK_YN = 'N' , PWD_FAIL_CNT = 0 , PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME = null , UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM' , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD = #{userCd} AND PWD_LOCK_YN = 'Y' AND PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME IS NOT NULL AND PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME <= NOW()

/* LoginMapper.updateUserPwdFail */ UPDATE TB_USER SET PWD_FAIL_CNT = PWD_FAIL_CNT + 1, PWD_LOCK_YN = CASE WHEN PWD_FAIL_CNT + 1 >= #{pwdFailMaxCnt} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME = CASE WHEN PWD_FAIL_CNT + 1 >= #{pwdFailMaxCnt} THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{lockDurationMinutes} MINUTE) ELSE NULL END, UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD = #{userCd}
mapper.select: /* LoginMapper.selectUserIdExistsGlobal */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} LIMIT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM TB_DAILY_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) T

/* LoginMapper.selectJoinConflictByUserId */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.USER_ID AS userId , A.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus , A.USE_YN AS useYn FROM TB_USER A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} LIMIT 1

/* LoginMapper.selectJoinConflictByMblHmac */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.USER_ID AS userId , A.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus , A.USE_YN AS useYn FROM TB_USER A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: /* LoginMapper.consumeSelfJoinSmsAuth */ UPDATE TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE SET VERIFIED_YN = 'C' , UPDATE_NO = 'SELF_JOIN' , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE SMS_ID = #{smsId} AND VERIFIED_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: /* LoginMapper.selectSelfJoinInactiveUserByUserId */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.USER_ID AS userId , A.USER_NM AS userNm , A.USER_PW AS userPw , A.AUTH_CD AS authCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, "AUTH_LEVEL", A.AUTH_CD, NULL) AS authLevel , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , B.SITE_NO AS siteNo , B.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , C.NODE_NM AS nodeNm , A.MBL_NO_ENC AS mblNoEnc , A.EMAIL_ENC AS emailEnc , A.PWD_LOCK_YN AS pwdLockYn , A.PWD_FAIL_CNT AS pwdFailCnt , A.PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME AS pwdLockExpireDtime , A.PWD_CHG_DTIME AS pwdChgDtime , A.WITHDRAWAL_DATE AS withdrawalDate , A.LAST_LOGIN_DTIME AS lastLoginDtime , A.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus , A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE AS employmentType , A.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , A.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , A.UPDATE_NO AS updateNo , A.UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate FROM TB_USER A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE_NODE C ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = C.SITE_CD AND A.NODE_CD = C.NODE_CD ) WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.ACCOUNT_STATUS IN ('06', '07') LIMIT 1

/* LoginMapper.selectRequiredTermsList */ SELECT A.SYST_VAL_D_CD AS termsId , A.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS termsNm , B.TERMS_VERSION AS termsVersion FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D A INNER JOIN TB_TERMS B ON ( A.SYST_VAL_D_CD = B.TERMS_ID AND B.REQUIRED_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE A.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS008' /* 이용약관 코드 조회 */

/* LoginMapper.selectUserTermsAgreementCheck */ SELECT A.TERMS_ID AS termsId , A.USER_TERMS_AGR_YN AS userTermsAgrYn FROM ( SELECT A.TERMS_ID , CASE WHEN A.TERMS_VERSION = B.TERMS_VERSION THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END USER_TERMS_AGR_YN FROM TB_TERMS A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TERMS_USER_AGR_MGMT B ON ( A.TERMS_ID = B.TERMS_ID AND A.TERMS_VERSION = B.TERMS_VERSION AND B.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND B.USER_CD = #{userCd} ) WHERE 1=1 /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T4: 웹 로그인 약관 팝업(TermsPop)은 '필수' 약관만 강제한다. 이 조건이 없으면 선택약관(006 연동 회사 제3자 제공 동의)이 팝업에 섞여 체크하지 않으면 로그아웃되는 사실상 강제 동의가 된다(자유의사 요건 파괴). 기존 약관 001~005 는 전부 REQUIRED_YN='Y' 라 현행 동작은 변하지 않는다. */ AND A.REQUIRED_YN = 'Y' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ) A WHERE A.USER_TERMS_AGR_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: /* LoginMapper.mergeAuthMenuInfo */ INSERT INTO TB_TERMS_USER_AGR_MGMT ( CMPNY_CD , USER_CD , TERMS_ID , TERMS_VERSION , AGR_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) SELECT #{cmpnyCd} AS CMPNY_CD , #{userId} AS USER_CD , TERMS_ID , TERMS_VERSION , 'Y' , #{userId} AS INSERT_NO , NOW() AS INSERT_DATE FROM TB_TERMS WHERE 1=1 AND TERMS_ID = #{systValDCd} /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T4: 웹 로그인 약관 팝업 경로는 '필수' 약관만 기록한다. 선택약관(006 제3자 제공 동의)은 반드시 ConsentHistoryRecorder 를 경유해야 전이 이력이 남는다. 이 경로로 006 이 기록되면 이력 없는 동의가 생겨 반출의 법적 근거가 무너진다. 대상 행이 없으면 INSERT...SELECT 가 0행 → 무해(멱등). */ AND REQUIRED_YN = 'Y' /* PK=(CMPNY_CD,USER_CD,TERMS_ID,TERMS_VERSION). 동일 약관 버전 재동의 시 PK 충돌로 트랜잭션이 롤백되는 것을 방지(멱등). 같은 버전 재동의면 동의값/시각만 갱신. */ ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE AGR_YN = VALUES(AGR_YN) , INSERT_NO = VALUES(INSERT_NO) , INSERT_DATE = NOW()
